detached_note: a pocket of water joined to the rest only through a channel narrower than a cell becomes an island of cells no route can reach. Dropped, and named in the run output — most are German and Norwegian inlets and Irish loughs severed by the 232 m mask, which is the Loch Etive limit in another place.
